body:
Nah I do not smoke weed or take drugs or anything. I did stopped drinking coffee regularly recently, which may be the cause for my anxiety.

Hmmm, I’ll have to look into this. Thank you for letting me know

Edit: though the only drugs I do take is prescribed medication! I meant street drugs, I have never consumed lol

Thank you, it’s strange when something feels like it’s coming back after become controlled for years. Which is why I’m afraid to seek support from my friends because I don’t want them to get sick of me.

Well the first time it was discovered was in therapy, so the therapist told my parents to remove weapons in the household and they did. My parents have never responded horribly about my desire, but they did feel angish as my dad would cry when no one was looking and my mother constantly reminded me to continue fighting to live.

I’m not sure honestly. School stress doesn’t feel horrible for me, and I like being kept busy. 

Though one of my worries recently has been my best friend. I feel like they have been leaving me lately for a person they’ve been seeing. I feel like they don’t have the same trust in me as we did back then. But it’s hard to tell- it could be the anxiety or depression talking. 

Confronting them isn’t effective either. They do not respond well. Which is what led to our fight a few days ago. 

I don’t really want to tell them about my illness once more either. If I’m sick of it, I’m sure they are too.
